characters.summary: Godkiller Deathstroke utilizes a specialized divine-forged blade that allows him to contend with and defeat mythological and god-like entities. In this form, his baseline physical attributes, martial arts mastery, and tactical brilliance are supplemented by an indestructible suit and a weapon designed to bypass divine durability.
weaknesses: reliance on the Godkiller suit and sword for peak performance against higher-tier divine beings
limitations: The Godkiller sword can be heavy or require specific adaptation depending on the foe.
characters.formDifferences: Equips Deathstroke with the divine Godkiller armor and the Godkiller sword, significantly increasing his capability against divine and mythological entities compared to his standard loadout.

sources.supports: General overview of Deathstroke history and New 52 series.
Details on the Godkiller armor, sword, and opponents defeated during the run.

feats.claim: Fought and defeated mythological titans and gods using the Godkiller sword.

campaignTags.claim: Wields the Godkiller sword, a divine artifact capable of slaying gods.
Wears the divine Godkiller armor suit.

unknowns: Exact limits of the Godkiller armor's durability against universal-scale energy blasts are not fully detailed.

characters.summary: Doctor Fate is a powerful sorcerer who harnesses the magic of Nabu via the Helmet of Fate, Amulet of Anubis, and Cloak of Destiny. He employs formidable spellcasting, energy projection, telekinesis, and flight to combat cosmic and mystical threats.
weaknesses: vulnerable when separated from the Helmet of Fate
host entity can be overwhelmed by external psychic manipulation
limitations: The human host often acts as a vessel and can be influenced or restricted by Nabu's will.

sources.supports: General history, magical artifacts, and powers of Doctor Fate.

feats.claim: Traveled between dimensions and manipulated time through pure spellcasting.

notableResults.note: Overpowered by the wrath of God.

campaignTags.claim: Doctor Fate flies naturally using magical energy.
Master sorcerer wielding the magic of Nabu.
Casts complex magical incantations and spells in combat.
Possesses vast psychic and telepathic abilities.
Can manipulate objects and opponents with the mind.

unknowns: Power levels vary significantly depending on the host's receptiveness and which iteration of Nabu is in control.

characters.summary: Doctor Manhattan possesses absolute quantum manipulation over matter and energy, allowing him to disintegrate opponents, duplicate himself, teleport anywhere, and perceive past, present, and future simultaneously.
weaknesses: tachyon fields disrupt his precognitive temporal awareness
limitations: Cannot simultaneously see through dense tachyon emissions.

sources.supports: Overview of Doctor Manhattan's origin, atomic powers, and feats.

feats.claim: Disintegrated entire military strike teams instantly with a wave of his hand.

notableResults.note: Confronted Superman but chose to alter his own timeline rather than fight to the death.

campaignTags.claim: Instantly teleports across planetary and interstellar distances.
Reconstructs his entire physical body after complete atomic disintegration.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of his reality-altering reach across multiple multiverses remain fluid.

characters.summary: Dream of the Endless (Morpheus) commands the realm of dreams and nightmares. He wields conceptual and reality-warping powers tied to the subconscious minds of all living beings, utilizing magical artifacts like his helm, dreamstone, and sand.
weaknesses: vulnerable when stripped of his primary sigils (helm, dreamstone, sand)
bound by ancient cosmic rules and limitations of his function
limitations: Bound by strict rules governing the Endless and cannot arbitrarily kill mortals without consequence.

sources.supports: Overview of Dream of the Endless, his artifacts, and conceptual nature.

feats.claim: Trapped a mortal in an endless loop of waking nightmares.

campaignTags.claim: Wields his Helm, Dreamstone, and bag of sand.

unknowns: The full extent of his power outside of the Dreaming and waking realms.

characters.summary: Etrigan the Demon is a fierce and brutal combatant bound to the mortal form of Jason Blood. He relies on hellfire projection, superhuman strength, invulnerability, and rhyming speech while engaging foes in close-quarters melee combat.
weaknesses: iron can cause him severe pain or hinder his magic
separation from Jason Blood or forced transformation back can incapacitate him
limitations: Compelled to speak in rhymes much of the time due to mystical constraints.

sources.supports: Overview of Etrigan's powers, hellfire, and connection to Jason Blood.

feats.claim: Fought evenly against powerful supernatural beings like Superman and Lobo in physical brawls.

notableResults.note: Subdued by Superman during a magical rampage.

conditional.dependsOn: Reciting the rhyming incantation by Jason Blood

campaignTags.claim: Breathes and projects destructive hellfire.
Possesses inherent demonic magic and spellcasting capabilities.
Can fly under his own demonic power.

unknowns: The exact upper limit of his strength when enraged in the depths of Hell.

characters.summary: Firestorm is a nuclear-powered superhero formed by the matrix fusion of two individuals. He can transmute elements, project intense thermal and radiation energy, fly at supersonic speeds, and phase through solid matter.
weaknesses: separation of the two minds inside the Firestorm matrix leaves them powerless
absorption of excessive amounts of raw energy can destabilize the matrix
limitations: Cannot transmute organic living matter permanently without severe difficulty.

sources.supports: Overview of Firestorm's nuclear powers, transmutation, and matrix mechanics.

feats.claim: Transmuted a falling mountain of solid rock into harmless snow.

campaignTags.claim: Flies through the air at high speeds using energy manipulation.
Generates and controls intense nuclear fire and thermal energy.

unknowns: Exact limits of transmuting complex alien substances without prior analysis.

characters.summary: General Zod is a Kryptonian military commander equipped with the same powers as Superman under a yellow sun: immense super strength, invulnerability, heat vision, super-speed, and flight. He fights with ruthless tactical training and brutal efficiency.
limitations: Powers deplete over time away from a yellow sun.

sources.supports: Overview of General Zod, Kryptonian physiology, and powers.

feats.claim: Fought evenly with Superman, leveling city blocks in combat.

notableResults.note: Defeated after a prolonged brutal engagement.

campaignTags.claim: Flies under the power of yellow sun radiation.

unknowns: Exact limits of his durability against specialized heavy anti-Kryptonian weaponry.

characters.summary: Giganta possesses the ability to increase her physical size to towering proportions, drastically enhancing her physical strength and durability while engaging opponents in brutal close-quarters brawls.
weaknesses: vulnerable to mental attacks while in giant form
large target for ranged energy attacks
limitations: Agility can be reduced at extreme sizes against faster opponents.

sources.supports: Overview of Giganta, size-changing powers, and Wonder Woman adversary role.

feats.claim: Lifted and hurled city buses and debris at Wonder Woman.

notableResults.note: Defeated in a head-to-head physical confrontation.

conditional.ability: Massive super strength and giant scale

campaignTags.claim: Can grow to enormous giant heights.
Reaches heights well over 20 feet when utilizing her growth powers.

unknowns: Maximum upper height limit before cellular strain occurs.

characters.summary: Gorilla Grodd is a hyper-intelligent super-gorilla gifted with immense physical strength and overwhelming telepathic powers, including mind control, mental blasts, and telekinesis.
weaknesses: overconfidence in his intellect and telepathic dominance
limitations: Physical speed is lower than high-tier speedsters without mental prediction.

sources.supports: Overview of Gorilla Grodd, intelligence, strength, and telepathy.

feats.claim: Mind-controlled an entire stadium of people simultaneously.

notableResults.note: Defeated by speed and clever misdirection.

campaignTags.claim: Impose mental control and communicate telepathically across vast distances.
Forces targets to obey his commands via mind control.
Manipulates physical objects with mental force.

unknowns: Full potential of his telepathy against cosmic entities with absolute mental resistance.

characters.summary: Green Arrow (Oliver Queen) is a master archer and peak-conditioned athlete who utilizes an arsenal of specialized trick arrows—including explosive, EMP, net, and cryonic arrows—to neutralize enemies from a distance.
weaknesses: human physical durability without meta-human powers
limited supply of specialized arrows before restocking
limitations: Ammunition is finite and requires manual replenishment during extended engagements.

sources.supports: Overview of Green Arrow, archery skills, and trick arrows.

feats.claim: Hit a falling drop of water with an arrow from hundreds of yards away.

notableResults.note: Won using tactical preparation and environmental advantage.

campaignTags.claim: Carries an extensive arsenal of trick arrows and tactical gear.

unknowns: Effectiveness against heavily armored opponents with near-absolute invulnerability without specific armor-piercing or high-explosive payloads.
